summary: RBAC: add/update role mappings so SRE on-call can perform Optimize config rollback in prod without granting broad Console admin
description:
Requester: SRE on-call

Context:
We’re onboarding the new Optimize config version history + one-click rollback flow. During the internal beta / Dedicated pilot we hit a permissions gap: SRE on-call cannot execute rollback in prod unless we temporarily grant a broad Console admin role.

Problem:
- Current role mappings do not include the new Optimize rollback permission for the on-call group(s).
- Workaround has been to add users to Console Admin / Platform Operator, which is too permissive for incident response.
- This is blocking the intended operational workflow: on-call should be able to rollback to a known-good config within minutes while apply/safe-apply remains restricted to a smaller operator set.

Request:
1) Create or update RBAC role mappings such that SRE on-call can:
   - View Optimize config version history + diffs for affected scopes
   - Execute rollback to a prior version in prod
   - View the resulting audit log entries / status
2) Do NOT grant:
   - optimize.config.apply (safe-apply / create+apply)
   - any broader Console admin permissions

Proposed permission set:
- Allow: optimize.config.rollback (+ required read permissions for history/compare endpoints)
- Deny: optimize.config.apply

Scope:
- Prod only (staging can keep current broad access until GA)
- Applies to the standard on-call group used for incident response (SRE primary + incident commander rotation)

Acceptance criteria:
- Member of SRE on-call group can click "Rollback" in Console for Optimize config and successfully execute rollback in prod.
- Member cannot access safe-apply / apply actions (UI hidden + API denied).
- Audit log reflects actor identity + role and logs rollback_attempted/rolled_back events.

References:
- SUP-2431: Dedicated tenant couldn’t see rollback UI due to RBAC/flag mismatch
- Slack thread: #eng-security discussion on RBAC/audit requirements (see eng-security/thread-1731091129)
- Runbook: Rollback Optimize config in production

Notes:
We need this in place before enabling rollback for the broader on-call pool. Target: before next release train cut (Connor O’Brien).

resolution:
Updated RBAC role mappings in prod to grant SREOnCall rollback-only access for Optimize config changes:
- Added optimize.config.rollback and required read/history permissions to SREOnCall role.
- Kept optimize.config.apply restricted to PlatformOperator/Console Admin.
- Confirmed Console hides apply actions when permission missing and API returns 403 for apply.
- Verified audit events for rollback include actor identity and request_id.

Follow-ups:
- Ensure Dedicated/Private tenants inherit the same least-privilege mapping patterns (track via ENG-4830).
- Consider adding a non-blocking “reason” field in rollback UI to improve auditability during incidents.
